sources.quote: build a reproducible filesystem image. This is equivalent to specifying -mkfs-time TIME and -inode-time TIME, which achieves reproducibility by setting all timestamps to TIME.
sources.teaches: mksquashfs 4.7.5 provides a reproducible-image option that fixes the filesystem and inode timestamps, so a lane-built fixture chain has stable digests

sources.anchor: the depth-limited remediation entry of the extraction-gap taxonomy
sources.quote: Rerun extract_firmware with a higher max_depth (up to 10) and a fresh output_directory to descend into this path.
sources.teaches: REA 6.5.0 names its own remedy for a depth-limited extraction: rerun with a higher max_depth (up to 10) and a fresh output_directory; a depth-limited path is a provider-declared boundary, not a missing file
